name: codex-review
description: Automatic post-commit code review using OpenAI Codex CLI. After every git commit, Codex reviews the changes and provides a PASS/FAIL verdict. On FAIL, Claude fixes issues and re-commits. On PASS, prompts to push to GitHub.

sandbox_mode.title: Sandbox mode
sandbox_mode.description: Sandbox policy for automatic post-commit Codex reviews.
